scoped_lineage_authority.explicitly_not_claimed: V6 is globally correct for all 503
scoped_lineage_authority.why: this programme established V6 is wrong for 22 securities and that 5 more carry original-ingest source-boundary failures; the scoping states what was verified, not that the defects went away

logical_datasets.name: minute_states
logical_datasets.rule: an UNOBSERVED minute has NO fabricated price or volume row

logical_datasets.name: observed_regular_bars
logical_datasets.contains: actual archived original-vintage regular-session bars only

eligibility_dimension.never_inferred_from: presence or absence of raw bars

empirical_justification.statement: incomplete minute coverage is the norm for a large-cap universe. Request-level completeness was proven; minute-emission completeness was not. Calling these minutes no-trade would be asserting the unproven half.

source_access_state.cohort_contract: the five known source-boundary securities are already excluded

no_synthetic_market_data.rule: every observed OHLCV row must correspond to an actual archived vendor bar

measured_trap.consequence: on an early-close session a 16:00 bar is EXTENDED HOURS. A hardcoded 16:00 close rule passes the ordinary fixture and mislabels this one.

extended_hours.definition: outside the regular lattice and outside the designated close boundary

vwap.reason: the source probe established vendor vw may lie outside [low, high]; true VWAP cannot be reconstructed from OHLCV
vwap.any_proxy_requires: its own preregistration under the name OHLCV_VWAP_PROXY

transaction_count.raw_n: may be preserved where the raw schema already does

higher_timeframe_rule.preserved_rule: if any constituent expected minute is UNOBSERVED, higher-timeframe coverage is incomplete/unavailable
higher_timeframe_rule.forbidden: silently aggregating across missing expected minutes

provenance.honesty_note: row-level raw-byte provenance is NOT implemented and must not be claimed

fail_closed_conditions: more than one close-boundary bar per security-session
source path outside guarded QUANT_RESEARCH storage

fixtures.name: early-close session
fixtures.trap: a 16:00 bar exists on this early-close session and is EXTENDED HOURS, not the close boundary. An implementation with a hardcoded 16:00 rule passes fixture A and silently mislabels this one.
fixtures.rule: the calendar determines the boundary; the clock never does

fixtures.name: session close boundary bar
fixtures.must_not: be counted as the 391st or 211th regular minute
fixtures.classification: neutral SESSION_CLOSE_BOUNDARY_BAR; NOT asserted to be an auction bar

fixtures.name: extended-hours bars
fixtures.rule: stored separately; may never populate regular minute states

population_context.meaning: incomplete minute coverage is the NORM, not an anomaly. This is why STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE stays unavailable — rendering these as zero-volume bars would manufacture 89% of this security's day.

fixtures.name: NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY from an ELIGIBLE V1 security
fixtures.note: GEV is the ONLY V1-eligible security with a NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY period — 22 of V6's 23 LISTED_LATER securities were excluded by the eligibility contract. This fixture is forced by measurement, not chosen for convenience.

fixtures.name: WHEN_ISSUED_EXCLUDED from an ELIGIBLE V1 security
fixtures.limitation: the ingest manifest has NO separate WHEN_ISSUED state and records this session as NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY. The distinction lives ONLY in the V6 lineage artifact, so this fixture must be validated against the lineage authority and NOT against the manifest.
fixtures.must_differ_from: fixture F, which is NOT_YET_REGULAR_WAY for the same security
fixtures.gev_survived: the anomaly qualification as a KNOWN_NON_ANOMALY control

fixtures.name: excluded V1 security must fail cohort admission
fixtures.construction: feed a security_key_v1 from the 27-member exclusion list

fixtures.name: supplemental / new-vintage payload path must fail
fixtures.construction: point the source resolver at the supplemental quarantine or a v7 diagnostic archive path

fixtures.name: duplicate source key must fail
fixtures.construction: inject a second bar for an existing (security_key_v1, timestamp)

fixtures.name: close-boundary duplication must fail
fixtures.construction: inject a second close-boundary bar into one security-session

fixtures.name: zero-fill / carry-forward attempt must fail
fixtures.construction: attempt to emit a synthetic OHLCV row for an UNOBSERVED expected minute

smoke_plan.negative_fixture_standard: each critical guard must show the dangerous version FAILS and the correct version PASSES; static assertions alone are insufficient

implementation_requirements.code_change_after_smoke: invalidate smoke, change hash, rerun from scratch
implementation_requirements.code_change_after_production: do not mix partitions across implementation hashes; HOLD and re-version

partitioning.scheme: session-major (date), consistent with the immutable canonical archive
partitioning.completion: a partition is sealed with a digest before being marked complete

claim_scope.frozen_claim: Historical 1-minute analysis of the data-qualified, original-vintage-only subset of the frozen current S&P 500 universe.
claim_scope.survivorship: current-503 membership is a known, accepted survivorship condition

known_limitations: fixture G cannot be validated against the ingest manifest, which has no WHEN_ISSUED state; it validates against the V6 lineage artifact only
GEV is the sole source for fixtures F and G because every other LISTED_LATER security was excluded
row-level raw-byte provenance is not implemented
STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE remains unavailable, so genuinely untraded minutes are indistinguishable from unserved ones in V2 output
